_comment: A partner file has no dedicated 'partner.*' key namespace — that was tried once and never wired up (routes/index.js's resolveCusto() never actually reached it), so it was removed. To brand a partner's pages, override the SAME event.*/subscription.* keys used at the event/season level — this file wins over them for that partner (see data_references/README.md > Customization files for the full layer order). Copy ONLY the keys you actually want to override into data/customization/partners/<slug>.json — do not paste the whole file.

event.lead.fr: Billetterie réservée aux ayants-droits de {{partnerName}} — Date : {{eventStartsAtFormatted}} · Lieu : {{venueName}}
event.lead.en: Ticketing reserved for {{partnerName}} rights holders — Date: {{eventStartsAtFormatted}} · Venue: {{venueName}}

subscription.lead.fr: Billetterie réservée aux ayants-droits de {{partnerName}} — l'abonnement donne accès à tous les matchs à domicile pour {{seasonCode}}.
subscription.lead.en: Ticketing reserved for {{partnerName}} rights holders — the season pass grants access to all home matches for {{seasonCode}}.
